text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 PAGE issued for tenant EdgeHealth — model quality drop detected in Dedicated pool eu-west-1-pool-12. Alert: regression in generation quality after recent quantization profile rollout. Impact: degraded responses for EdgeHealth production traffic (errors low but semantic drift high).
oncall-Alex: on it. seeing increased customer complaints forwarded from support. linking logs...
ml-ana: I pulled eval diffs vs yesterday — large BLEU/ROUGE-ish drop on the prompt set we run for EdgeHealth. Change window shows `quant-profile:v3` applied 02:12 UTC to the dedicated pool.
ml-ana: suspect quantization precision change (float16->int4 mixed) causing hallucinations on the medical-context prompts.
sre-Jules: @oncall-Alex can you confirm which machines/containers got the new profile?
oncall-Alex: `kubectl get pods -n dedicated-edgehealth --selector=pool=eu-west-1-pool-12` shows workers rolled between 02:12-02:18. Deployment `worker-pool-edgehealth` updated with configmap `quant-profile:v3`.
eng-runtime-Kim: if it's configmap rollout we can revert with the previous config immediately. risk: brief token loss while pods restart.
ml-ana: recommended immediate mitigation: revert to `quant-profile:v2`, pin model to `rdx-13b:v2` for EdgeHealth, and start canary with a small percentage on v3 after further evals.
solutions-Ravi: I'm drafting a message to the EdgeHealth SE and CSM — need a quick timeline and what we will do.
customer-success-Maya: I just got the customer on a call — they're seeing medically unsafe outputs in 2 of 5 sampled sessions. They want rollback now.
oncall-Alex: action plan (short):
1) revert configmap to `quant-profile:v2`
2) rollout restart of `worker-pool-edgehealth` with zero-downtime strategy (2 pods at a time)
3) pin tenant routing to `rdx-13b:v2` via routing-policy override
4) run accelerated regression evals on the owners' prompt set
5) notify customer and keep them on the call
ml-ana: I'll run the evals — need about 10 mins after pods are back up.
sre-Jules: I'll take the revert and restart. executing now.
eng-runtime-Kim: thumbs on rollback command if you want me to run it:```bash
kubectl apply -f quant-profile-v2-configmap.yaml -n dedicated-edgehealth
kubectl rollout restart deploy/worker-pool-edgehealth -n dedicated-edgehealth --max-unavailable=1
```
sre-Jules: running apply now. tailing logs.
incident-bot: deploy-bot: rollout started for deploy/worker-pool-edgehealth by sre-Jules at 02:45 UTC.
eng-runtime-Kim: also applying tenant pin:```bash
redwood routing set --tenant edgehealth --model rdx-13b:v2 --scope dedicated --force
```
sre-Jules: restart in progress, pods terminating 1-by-1. no crashloops observed.
oncall-Alex: handing off — I'm stepping away for 30m. @sre-Jules you're primary, @ml-ana please drive evals.
sre-Jules: acknowledged handoff, I'll coordinate with eng-runtime-Kim and ml-ana.
ml-ana: pods back up. kicking eval harness against live prompt set now.
ml-ana: preliminary: quality metrics back within expected range on the sampled set, hallucination rate dropped to baseline. attaching small sample of before/after in thread.
ml-ana: recommend keeping `quant-profile:v2` for 24h and then run a controlled A/B with v3 on non-production prompts.
solutions-Ravi: message to customer drafted: "We detected a regretful quality regression after a quantization profile update affecting your dedicated pool. We reverted the profile and pinned the model; quality metrics indicate restoration to baseline. We will run further validation and propose a scheduled A/B test for the improved profile once validated." Want to add anything?
customer-success-Maya: add ETA for full verification: 4 hours, and offer a postmortem and optional extended logs for their compliance team.
eng-runtime-Kim: monitoring in Grafana shows latency stable, token error rate unchanged — regression purely quality.
ml-ana: creating follow-up eval ticket: EVAL-1234 with full artifacts + reproducible test harness + small prompt set.
sre-Jules: marking incident as mitigated in status page, but keeping oncall for watch for 2 hours.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident mitigation: quantization profile revert + model pin applied. Severity: customer-impact P1 -> mitigated.
ml-ana: postmortem items: 1) strengthen pre-rollout evals for tenant-specific prompt sets, 2) add canary gating to configmap changes on dedicated pools, 3) auto-alert on sudden quality metric shifts.
oncall-Alex: back online and stepping back in — good job team.
customer-success-Maya: customer acknowledged and appreciated the quick revert. they'll expect the postmortem and invite us to their compliance review next week.
sre-Jules: scheduling a 1hr incident review at 09:30 UTC today. invite: @ml-ana @eng-runtime-Kim @solutions-Ravi @customer-success-Maya @oncall-Alex.
ml-ana: noted. saving logs and diffs to the incident ticket.
eng-runtime-Kim: I'll follow up with a safe rollout checklist for configmap changes on dedicated pools.
incident-bot: incident closed for paging purposes — follow-up actions tracked in ticket INC-EDGE-2026-042.
